findingDetails.title: Pre-existing untracked deletions disappear from the baseline diff
findingDetails.evidence: The detector iterates current status entries only, so a baseline-only untracked path deleted before sampling is omitted.
findingDetails.recommendation: Compare the baseline/current path union and preserve baseline bytes for a missing path.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Tracked deletions remain visible, but untracked baseline deletions do not.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The detector and baseline contract are in scope.

findingDetails.title: Failed or incomplete lanes skip containment entirely
findingDetails.evidence: Failure gates throw before the containment call.
findingDetails.recommendation: Invoke containment in a failure-safe path before rethrowing the lane error.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Successful lanes reach containment, but the failure gates do not.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The runner ordering controls target CLI lineages.

findingDetails.title: Quarantine destinations are not canonicalized before trusted writes
findingDetails.evidence: writeQuarantineFile creates and writes the supplied destination without validating its resolved path; quarantineViolations supplies fixed and nested destinations below the artifact directory.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve and validate every artifact, containment, quarantine, content, patch, and manifest destination against the canonical artifact root before creating or writing it; reject the run's containment record before any external write.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Detector-side target canonicalization and target symlink tests do not validate the trusted quarantine destination.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The trusted quarantine writer is part of the target containment implementation and NFR-S01 is explicit.
